lead: Irrfan Khan was an Indian stage actor, born on 7 January 1967 in Tonk.
He died on 29 April 2020 in Mumbai at the age of 53.
He is associated with work such as Hindi Medium, Karwaan and Blackmail and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and CNN-News18 Indian of the Year.
Below you will find a verified overview of Irrfan Khan: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Irrfan Khan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Irrfan Khan works primarily as a stage actor, film actor and television actor.
Among the credits most often linked to Irrfan are Hindi Medium, Karwaan, Blackmail, Paan Singh Tomar, Madaari, The Namesake, The Lunchbox, Life of Pi, Slumdog Millionaire and Piku.
